title: Mixed Event — STRAY BAD DOG

meta.Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD shows signs of growth, inspired by changes in Toya. One day, they'll be able to reach the heights of that legendary night. With that thought in his head, Akito learns of the man said to be the closest to surpassing RAD WEEKEND...!

rows.Line: A small live house

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Vivid BAD SQUAD's just off the hook!!

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Whoa... They were good the last time I saw them, but did they get better since then...?

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Yeah, there's no stopping them either. They're gonna go places if they keep this up...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Nice, we're doing good. This is the most hyped the crowd's been today too...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Those two have been improving faster than I expected. They might even pass me if I'm not careful...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This almost feels nostalgic. It reminds me of when I heard Toya sing for the first time...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I've gotta keep going too...!)
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright...
That might've been the best we've ever done.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. We connected well with the crowd too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
That feeling's seriously the best!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
My heart was pounding then!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we can't be satisfied with just this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND.
This stuff has to come easy to us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We know!
We just gotta keep practicing and do even better in our next event!
The next day
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, that should be enough...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm? Akito, you're already here...?
Do you always start warming up this early in the morning?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It takes a while for me to get my throat warmed up. Our next event is coming up, so I need to be here two hours in advance during full practice days.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. You really seem eager.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Says you.
Toya, I know you've been practicing on your own a lot more too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True. However, I wouldn't so much call it eagerness instead of something that just naturally started happening over time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then we're one and the same. On top of that, I feel like we're finally hitting our stride as a team.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (To be fair, there's more to it than just that...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Toya's been singing better ever since he got over whatever was going on between him and his dad.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (An isn't making the same mistakes she did when we first joined up anymore and really gets how to sing as a group now.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And Kohane's been growing faster than any of us expected. Who knows how high her ceiling goes...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We're gelling as a team and finally even managed to catch a decent wave. I've gotta keep doing what I can too...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hm?
You two are super early!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good morning, Shinonome, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Morning.
You're here early too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought that maybe I should start warming up sooner. But you're here an hour early... When exactly did you wake up?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Um... A little before 6 am?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? That's way too early, gramps.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're here too, so that makes you a granny, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Granny?! I'm a young high school girl, you know?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyways, we're all here now, so let's get started.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, hold that thought!
The four of us singing together here would cause a bunch of noise complaints.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How about over there?
bgm_area00003
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We're here!
Hm? Do you hear that?

I'm so sorry!
It was all my fault! Please, forgive me!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It sounds like a man...?

No way!
I won't forgive you for this!

Yeah!
That was Len's favorite, you know?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That sounds like Rin and Len...
Maybe they're having an argument at MEIKO's place...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No idea, but let's go and take a look!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This is just gonna be another dumb fight, isn't it...?
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
MEIKO! Miku!
What's going on here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, An.
Welcome.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, I think you can see for yourself...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
How could you do that, KAITO?!
Len was keeping that ice cream for later!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd been saving it since yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: KAITO... Wait, KAITO?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. I'm not sure where he was this whole time, but he came in not too long ago.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It may've only been a matter of time until we saw him here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh, sure...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why did you eat my ice cream anyway?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, I... I came by MEIKO's cafe and my stomach started to growl...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I thought that I should stop by and ask for something to eat, but MEIKO wasn't there. She might've been getting ready in the back.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I took the liberty of peeking into the freezer and I found your ice cream.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You two always have your names written on the ones that are reserved for you, so I thought that MEIKO left this one in there for me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: More importantly, why do you keep rummaging through my freezer like that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, it's my fault for not writing my name on it, but you should at least ask first...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm sorry! In return... Oh, I know!
I'll teach you how to use my sampler!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Well...
If you'll teach me everything you know, then I might think about forgiving you...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Really? Oh, thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What's a sampler...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's a device that lets you record sounds, save songs and even mix them together however you like. I'm sure you've seen other DJs use them before.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait a second, he's a DJ?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, he is. He's very good at it too and knows how to get a crowd going. Len's sort of an apprentice of his.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
I'd like to hear him play sometime.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Oh, is that...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Let me introduce you to them, KAITO.
These are the ones that created this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, okay! It's a pleasure to meet you! My name is KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it is a little unfortunate to meet you under these circumstances. Haha...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-It's nice to meet you too...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it's our pleasure as well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, everybody!
Since you're all here, wanna try being a DJ with us? KAITO said he'd show me a bunch of stuff!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry, but we're here for singing practice today...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Okay, fine... Maybe next time...!
Anyways, KAITO, are you ready?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I am. Shall we get started?
How about we try doing...
se_event_stray_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What was that...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That was such a strange sound.
Like an airhorn or something...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, also! You can even use sounds like this! Isn't it amazing?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He said he'd teach him how to use his sampler, but it sounds like they're just messing around...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I know MEIKO said he's good, but he doesn't seem serious about it at all...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Anyways, I have other things I need to worry about right now.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, it's about time we got started. Getting here early won't mean anything if we keep being entranced by them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're gonna practice like crazy and do even better at our next event!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Yeah!
Live House
Outside the live house

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yes, things went perfectly today too!
I'm glad we practiced so much!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it was worth getting up so early every morning.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I agree! I'm so glad everything we practiced each morning turned out so well!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, wait...! I left my phone inside!
Sorry, I'll be right back...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Really? I'll go with you.
You two wait out here, okay?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We will.

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line:
Today was so awesome!
And when did Vivid BAD SQUAD get this good?

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
Almost as good as that other guy we saw!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (That other guy...?)

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Yeah, they're pretty good too! I've never seen a crowd as pumped up as that one was!

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: That guy also said something about putting on an event that surpassed RAD WEEKEND too...

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND, as in THE RAD WEEKEND...? I don't know much about it, but everyone's saying it's not possible.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Surpass RAD WEEKEND...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Um, excuse me. Do you have a minute...?

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line:
Hm? Whoa!
You're from Vivid BAD SQUAD...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Who is this other guy you were talking about?
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Arata Tono, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Apparently, he's been participating in quite a few events lately and has the singing voice to match.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's even openly claimed that he'll find a way to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Arata Tono...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't think anyone else would be out there chasing after RAD WEEKEND like we are...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we should take it as a challenge. We should see what we're up against.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sh-Shinonome, you're scaring me a little...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Don't mind him, Azusawa. He makes that face more often than you think.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, now I remember!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This Arata, I think they've stopped by to talk to Dad before!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To Ken?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Like three years ago when we were still in junior high... Hey, Daaad!

rows.Speaker: An's dad
rows.Line: Hm? Are you ordering something?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, not that. Do you remember talking to someone named Arata Tono?

rows.Speaker: An's dad
rows.Line: Arata Tono...? Oh, him!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes! I knew it!

rows.Speaker: An's dad
rows.Line: Right, about three years ago, I'd say. He said he was going abroad to train, but I guess he's back now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Abroad...?
Is that why we don't know about him?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad, what's this Arata person like?

rows.Speaker: An's dad
rows.Line:
He's a good kid.
He was still a junior high schooler when I first met him, but he had a natural talent for getting a crowd going.

rows.Speaker: An's dad
rows.Line: And he did mention something about surpassing RAD WEEKEND like you guys are...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Surpass RAD WEEKEND like us...

rows.Speaker: An's dad
rows.Line: A lot of other performers started looking out for him, and even his partner...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Partner?
He has a partner?

rows.Speaker: An's dad
rows.Line: Yeah, or he did...

rows.Speaker: An's dad
rows.Line: But I didn't know he was back and became this good...

rows.Speaker: An's dad
rows.Line: I'd like to see what he's like now too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even Ken thinks he might be the real deal.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, now I'm really curious! Which event do you think he'll be in next?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Maybe we can look at his social media profile...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, here! He doesn't have an account, but his fans are saying, I'm definitely going to your event next week! Apparently, at a live house right near here too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Then we gotta go next week too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree...
Keep your schedules open, okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Arata Tono, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks for having us, Ken.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: See you tomorrow, Shiraishi, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. Bye, Aoyagi, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Later!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Mind if we try one song before we head home?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wanna make sure that I don't forget how we got that crowd going today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's go to our usual spot then...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? There's more people here than usual. Is there an event or something going on?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Possibly. It looks like everyone's waiting in anticipation for something...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
I don't believe this!
Arata's actually crashing this event!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: But I feel kinda bad for the guys that came before. Arata's gonna end up getting all the attention.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Arata...?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Oh! Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's him...

Hey... Whoa, so many people!
Who are you all waiting for, anyways?

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Haha. You, Arata!

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Hey, come do a show at my friend's place! All the big names from around here will be there!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, really? I might just have to take you up on that!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So that's Tono...
We're about the same age.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He seems very charming like Ken said.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, he does...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But he wants to surpass RAD WEEKEND too? He doesn't seem all that serious about it but...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No, I shouldn't judge a book by its cover...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I have to actually see to make sure.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's go, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We don't even have to wait until next week. We can see him right now!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We gotta see what he's made of.
I need to see for myself...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A-Akito...!
Outside the Vivid Street live house

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Hey, are you free after this? A few of my musician friends are getting together, so wanna join us?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, sorry! I have a date with a chocolate parfait after this show! I sort of can't miss it!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Apologies, but I'll be... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry to interrupt you, but are you Arata Tono?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I perform around here and have been hearing a lot of rumors about someone named Tono...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, would you mind if we could have a little chat?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Wait, is that Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: You're right, it's him!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hm? I feel like I've seen you before...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'm Akito Shinonome.
I sing for Vivid BAD SQUAD.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, Vivid BAD SQUAD!
I've been to one of your events!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really? Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: And you're his teammate too, no? Nice to meet you, I'm Arata Tono.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, um... It's nice to meet you.
My name is Toya Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're partners on the same team.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Partners, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
I see.
Good for you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (What was that? Something's changed all of a sudden...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Would you mind us asking a quick question, Tono?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Of course, if it's something I can answer.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then... Is it true that your dream is to surpass RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, it is. Well, to put it into better perspective...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I don't want to surpass RAD WEEKEND, I will surpass it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tono, were you actually at RAD WEEKEND...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, of course!
My best friend was really into music and dragged me along to go see it.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: We sort of got caught up in the moment and decided that we'd put on an even bigger event together.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: So in a way, it's not my dream to surpass RAD WEEKEND, rather my friend's...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But we heard that you've been participating in events on your own...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Yes, I have.
Well, things happened.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Now, I'm working to surpass it all on my own.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Surpass RAD WEEKEND on your own...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're being serious?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you were actually there, you'd know that it's not realistic for just one person to do that on their own...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, I'm more than aware of that.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But I believe that I am more capable of doing that than you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: You also wish to surpass RAD WEEKEND too, no?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So you knew...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, I did. I started hearing rumors just after I came back.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: That Vivid BAD SQUAD wants to put on an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But you've honestly been a disappointment...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I was hoping for more since Ken spoke so highly of your team.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What exactly do you mean by that...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
My, what a scary face.
Excuse that last comment.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: However, my declaration still stands. You do not have what it takes to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: With time, I'm sure you'll go somewhere, but I'll have long since succeeded by then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still haven't seen you perform, but I wouldn't get so cocky now either.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, it's nothing like that.
I'm just speaking my mind.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: It still hasn't gotten through to you yet, so let me explain it in simpler terms...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Aoyagi, was it?
You seem to have quite an ear and perfect pitch to match. Your incredible talents are going to waste.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: And that An girl has been doing well for herself too. Ken's daughter should be able to do as much, but she still needs more polishing...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: And that other girl, I forget her name... She has some manner of singing talent, but still too amateurish during live performances.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I would never have let her join in the first place.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You...!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: And above all else...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I've heard enough...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All this talk means you have to be that much better than us, right?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, naturally.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then let's find out who's actually better.
You or us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If we can get this crowd more pumped up than you, you'll take back what you just said.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Hey, does this mean Arata and Vivid BAD SQUAD are gonna duke it out...?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: No way! That would be amazing!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
So it's a battle you want?
Fine. Everybody here seems to be itching to see one too.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Hey, you there.
Mind if we borrow some of your equipment?

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Go for it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You can sing, right?
You sounded fine just now, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you sure you want to do this? What good can actually come out of this...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then what do you suggest we do?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We can't just let him rag on us like that...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Besides, you don't have to do it, because I will.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I'll sing too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm your partner. You're not doing this alone.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's keep this simple. You can choose any song you like and the one that gets the crowd more pumped up is the winner.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Fine, so be it.
Who goes first?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We are.
We're gonna end things before you even get a chance.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Haha. Your confidence is commendable. But you'll need more than that to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I know.
That's all we've been working towards this whole time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're not doing this for fun.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Not doing this for fun, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Everything's all set!
So, who's going first?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We are.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: FYI, we're not holding back.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Be my guest. Give it everything you have.
song00008_off_s

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Whoa...! Right out of the gates!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah, and this is the first BAD DOGS performance in a while too! This is awesome!

rows.Speaker: Arata

Let's get a hold of Akito and...

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Hey! Is Toya here?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, you! That guy from before...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry... What was your name?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Kotaro Mita!
But that's not why I'm here...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I'm supposed to be in this event with Akito today, but something's wrong with him...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
With Akito?
What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: We're doing a battle event today, but this other guy, Arata Tono, just decided to crash it. Akito looked like he'd just snapped or something...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I don't know how to put it into words, but it's like he's his old self again, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
His old self...?
What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: You know? When you guys just became the BAD DOGS? I mean, seriously...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Please, continue. Tell us everything you know.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: You guys had it pretty rough back then, right? The older musicians were picking on you, and even the crowd was always getting in your face...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I remember...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Even you guys had to deal with that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We did. But that was also when we were desperately doing everything we could to get better. Akito in particular had this aura about him, even during practice...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He worked so hard on trying to make it as a performer and surpass “that night”. I struggled to keep up with him.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I can totally see that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shinonome has a really good work ethic so...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But what does that have to do with what's happening now?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Maybe that's how it looked to you, Toya, but not to us. That went way beyond what the rest of us called “hard-working”...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: He kept at it, even when you weren't there. Day and night, regardless if he could even physically sing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I couldn't get much out of him then, but I think he was trying to keep up with you...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: With me...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, you have a classical music background, so your musical intuition is through the roof. He probably felt that someone way beyond him just came onto the scene...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Other people have even been saying that Akito is living off his partner's talents...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're kidding! That's awful!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm the one that's holding us back.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's not true.
Akito, you've...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It is true. I know better than anyone else...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you for telling us, Mita.
Do you know where Akito is now?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: He's... He's at that live house... BROWN!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Got it...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, Toya...!
We're going too, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!
A small live house

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's been a while...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, Shinonome.
Yes, it has!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
You're performing as well, I see?
Is Aoyagi not with you today?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's just me today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But don't think that I'm gonna let you walk away with a win so easily.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Such pressure...
You've practiced quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: This might make you mad, but that makes me happy. Seeing you like this gets me more motivated.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Whatever...
I'll make you eat those words later.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Haha. That's the spirit!
Let's make this a good one, shall we?

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Next, let's give it up for Crash Gag!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Ken was right. This guy's way better than anyone else here.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I worked harder than anyone else to get where I am now.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'll make him pay for what he said that day right here, right now...!)

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Next, from the team that's absolutely on fire right now, Vivid BAD SQUAD'S Akito!!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Hey, he seems different today. Like he has an aura or something, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah, maybe it's because he lost to Arata. Is he here to get revenge?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Akito's good, but against Arata...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I don't care who I'm going up against, I'm not backing down.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I have to get past even my own limits if I want to surpass RAD WEEKEND...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Ever since that day, I've been chasing and chasing...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Everyone laughed at me for saying that I'll find a way to surpass RAD WEEKEND even though I couldn't sing at all back then...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I finally made it this far. I got back up every time I was knocked down.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (So there's no way I'm backing away from another hurdle that gets in my way!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Whoa!! I never knew Akito could sing like this...!!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: No, he's never had this kind of power! Where did he learn to unleash like this?!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Shut up, you guys! I can't hear him!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I'll have to get serious too then...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
Akito, that was unbelievable!
Who can possibly top that?!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Next is the new kid on the block that everyone's talking about. Give it up for Arata!!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: That was a solid performance. I didn't expect you to improve this much in less than a month.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But that's still not enough to beat me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Wh-What is this...?!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: This goes way beyond what you'd expect to hear at a place like this...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Was he holding back that time...?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: He's incredible! If he can do this much, he might actually be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (After all that, I didn't even scratch the surface...)

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
What a performance by Arata!!
Could this be our champion?!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: There's no way anyone else here can top that!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: I know, right?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (What am I supposed to do...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I didn't get any closer. I'm further back than I realized...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Is this it...? Is this my limit...?)
Akito!
What? The event's already over?
If it's still on, can't we just jump in and crash it?

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Hold on! Looks like we've got all of Vivid BAD SQUAD in the house!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why are you guys here...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You can still sing, right, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What do you plan on doing?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Isn't it obvious?
We're all doing a song together!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're not alone anymore. Vivid BAD SQUAD is here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's sing as a team, Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: As long as we're together, we'll be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you saying all the sudden...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I didn't realize just how hard you were working back then and even now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Toya...!
You...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have so much respect for the way you've been doing everything in your power to make your dream come true. I understand your desire to do everything yourself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you don't need to do that anymore...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If it weren't for you, Akito, I wouldn't have been able to get this far.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You were the one that lifted my spirits after that day we met on Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now, it's my turn.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Let's keep performing and doing shows together until you get over this hurdle.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If you still feel down after that, I'll be there to lift you back up. I'll make sure that you'll be able to sing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because there's no way we'll be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND without you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So if something's bothering you, ask us for help!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Seriously, you've been helping us so much until now! You even told me and Kohane what we needed to work on and deal with...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She's right! It's all thanks to you, Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I don't have the talent that they do...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But if we're gonna actually put on an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND, I need to get better. I don't know if I can make that a reality the way I am now...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I don't have time to think about whether or not I have any talent, or if I have to chase after anyone.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I have to keep standing back up if I'm gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND with them!!)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, you're performing as Vivid BAD SQUAD now? Good, I'd like to see this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Tono...
I know I don't have what it takes to beat you....

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we're gonna be the ones that surpass RAD WEEKEND...!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Whoa! This power...!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah! They can't stand up to Arata on their own, but when they're together...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (How are we doing this...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I froze up and didn't know what to do after I heard him sing...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I honestly believe that I can surpass RAD WEEKEND as long as I'm with them...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
I see...
Now I understand.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... *Huff*...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We're Vivid BAD SQUAD, everyone!
We'll be counting on your support!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The crowd went wild...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Are you finally starting to get it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't care if you want to try stuff on your own, but we're surpassing RAD WEEKEND as a team, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This isn't just your dream.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
I was being an idiot...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: MC, can we hold off on deciding a winner for now...?

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I'm suggesting that we call a draw just for today. That'll make things more interesting for next time and draw an even bigger crowd, no?

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: H-Hey, don't just take the mic...!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: So, there you have it! We're calling it a draw! Thank you for the great performance, Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: What?! How can you end things like this?!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: But it did get pretty good in the end. A draw might be the right call here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I see what you did there!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I don't think we've met!
You're Arata, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm An from Vivid BAD SQUAD!
This is my partner, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: N-Nice to meet you...!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Yes, it's nice to finally meet you.
You must be Ken's daughter.
And Kohane, was it...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
I promise not to forget.
That was a good performance.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, you did great too!
Things got pretty exciting there, huh?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
You made this event a big success.
Let's do it again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I'll see you at the next event...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'll admit defeat.
You win today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I at least need to make that much clear for myself.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But I'm not about to stop.
Just wait, I'm gonna keep getting better.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: And I'll be looking forward to seeing that...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: See you later, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (He has a good team...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (If only they were here too...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: No, now's not the time for that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That Arata guy's really good!
He can sing and he seemed so nice!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What are you talking about...?
He's gonna be our rival from now on.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Relax, I know!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Y-You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? You're here too?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I was here the whole time! Also, I'm the one that told you guys about this event!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
But you four really are something else!
You looked a lot better when you were with them too, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks for bringing them here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, how about we get back on the right track!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If we're gonna have a hope of surpassing RAD WEEKEND, we've gotta do it together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Mind if I add just one thing...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Yes, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I convinced myself that in order for us to surpass RAD WEEKEND, I needed to become as good as I possibly could.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm sorry about that. I didn't realize what I was doing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still believe that I need to get better for us to make our dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But from now on, I'll try relying on you guys more...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now, practices are gonna get even harder, so I hope you're all ready.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You know we are!
Don't worry about us!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah!
Let's keep trying our best, Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
We can do this, together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, you guys. Let's go!
